name: Tsuki no Nai Michi 2
source:
Main character is appointed to executive committee for the culture festival. When preparations get ruined, he starts investigation to catch the criminal. But is it really a prank? What awaits him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角被任命为文化节执行委员会成员。当准备工作被破坏时，他开始调查以抓捕罪犯。但这真的是恶作剧吗？等待他的是什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
